Category: SaaS Upfront Setup Fee Immediate Recognition
Transaction_Description: SaaS client billed ,000 in professional implementation setup fees across 12 enterprise contracts in Q4 and recognized 100% immediately as revenue upon invoicing.
Management_Explanation: VP of Sales stated setup services are completely distinct and deliver immediate standalone value to customers.
Investigative_Questions_Asked: QRY-007: Review ASC 606 performance obligations in Enterprise Master Services Agreements. Can customer utilize software without implementation? Is setup distinct?

Evidence_Verification_Result: Contradicted: Software cannot operate without proprietary custom integration; setup services do not have standalone value; under ASC 606, setup must be combined with the subscription and amortized over the initial contract term (average 36 months).
Root_Cause_Established: Aggressive revenue recognition violation of ASC 606 to inflate ARR and near-term revenue.
Downstream_QoE_Impact: Downstream EBITDA Reduction of -,000 in FY23; Balance Sheet Deferred Revenue liability increase of ,000.
Reviewer_Conclusion: Material quality of earnings adjustment. Strip out unearned setup fees from historical revenue and establish proper deferred revenue opening balance.

Category: Aged GRNI Clearing Account Balance (Stale Accrued Purchases)
Transaction_Description: GRNI subledger contains ,200 of open purchasing accruals originating between 180 and 420 days ago that have never received vendor invoices.

Downstream_QoE_Impact: Working Capital adjustment: Eliminate ,200 stale liability; Downstream EBITDA: Treat as prior-period non-operating credit (do not allow management to take EBITDA credit in LTM).
Reviewer_Conclusion: Remove from working capital; prevent management from recognizing a one-off EBITDA gain upon release.
